How blackjack works, in under a minute.

Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Face cards count 10, an ace is 1 or 11, and you hit or stand. The catch: you play first, so if you bust you lose even when the dealer busts too. That rule is where most of the casino's edge comes from.
